description: This file defines API routes related to authentication processes such as user registration, login, and profile retrieval using FastAPI. It includes route handlers that interact with an authentication service and database session, handling user creation, token issuance, and current user info retrieval.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's router instance used to define route handlers for authentication endpoints.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration by delegating to AuthService and manages exceptions for duplicate emails and validation errors.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(AuthService)], )
methods.description: Handles user login by authenticating credentials via AuthService and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(AuthService)], )
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile details.
